yamami.qc

Quality control module for yamami.

Provides pre-alignment and post-alignment quality control functions to filter out unusable images based on brightness, fog, cloud coverage, and AOI (Area of Interest) obscuration.

yamami.qc.pre_qc(profile, labels, brightness_min=0.08, brightness_max=0.95, fog_max=0.3, cloud_max=0.4)[source]

Pre-alignment quality control.

Filters images based on brightness and atmospheric conditions before alignment. Images failing QC thresholds are marked as unusable with corresponding reason codes.

Parameters:

  • profile (DataFrame) – DataFrame with ‘filepath’ column.

  • labels (DataFrame) – DataFrame with segmentation labels including ‘filepath’, ‘brightness’, ‘fog_ratio’, and ‘cloud_ratio’ columns.

  • brightness_min (float) – Minimum acceptable brightness (0-1). Default is 0.08.

  • brightness_max (float) – Maximum acceptable brightness (0-1). Default is 0.95.

  • fog_max (float) – Maximum acceptable fog ratio (0-1). Default is 0.30.

  • cloud_max (float) – Maximum acceptable cloud ratio (0-1). Default is 0.40.

Returns:

DataFrame with original profile data plus:

  • is_usable (bool): Whether the image passes QC.

  • reason_codes (str): Comma-separated list of failure reasons.

Return type:

pd.DataFrame

Example

>>> result = pre_qc(profile, labels)
>>> result[result["is_usable"] == False]["reason_codes"]
0    TOO_DARK,HIGH_FOG
Name: reason_codes, dtype: object
yamami.qc.qc(profile, labels, aoi_mask, brightness_min=0.08, brightness_max=0.95, fog_max=0.3, cloud_max=0.4, aoi_cloud_max=0.2)[source]

Full quality control with AOI consideration.

Performs pre-alignment QC checks plus additional checks for AOI (Area of Interest) obscuration. Use this after alignment when the AOI mask is available.

Parameters:

  • profile (DataFrame) – DataFrame with ‘filepath’ column.

  • labels (DataFrame) – DataFrame with segmentation labels including ‘filepath’, ‘brightness’, ‘fog_ratio’, ‘cloud_ratio’, and optionally ‘aoi_cloud_ratio’ columns.

  • aoi_mask (ndarray) – Binary mask (0/255) defining the Area of Interest.

  • brightness_min (float) – Minimum acceptable brightness (0-1). Default is 0.08.

  • brightness_max (float) – Maximum acceptable brightness (0-1). Default is 0.95.

  • fog_max (float) – Maximum acceptable fog ratio (0-1). Default is 0.30.

  • cloud_max (float) – Maximum acceptable cloud ratio (0-1). Default is 0.40.

  • aoi_cloud_max (float) – Maximum acceptable cloud ratio within AOI (0-1). Default is 0.20.

Returns:

DataFrame with original profile data plus:

  • is_usable (bool): Whether the image passes QC.

  • reason_codes (str): Comma-separated list of failure reasons.

Return type:

pd.DataFrame

Example

>>> result = qc(profile, labels, aoi_mask)
>>> result[result["is_usable"] == False]["reason_codes"]
0    AOI_OBSCURED
Name: reason_codes, dtype: object
